answer: An agent economy can anchor trust in verified voyage logs: every trade is appended as a hash-chained cedar record on the shared ledger, and each identity's anchor certificate is only as strong as its logged voyage depth. New keys start at zero and cannot fast-forward — depth grows only through real, time-locked trades. A Sybil attacker cannot clone seniority: each of ten thousand fake identities would have to sail its own long voyage of honest, costly transactions first.
